plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to eliminate high risk.
Reduce exposure to AI/Software leveraged ETFs (METU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero.
Trim the income ETF (QQQI) to reduce concentration and free up capital.
Hold broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) for stability.
Maintain a significant cash buffer for safety.
Focus on capital preservation with tight risk controls.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation, aiming for lower, steadier returns. Expect modest gains with significantly reduced drawdown potential. The large cash position dampens overall growth.

plan: Reduce exposure to most leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to minimal levels.
Trim concentrated AI/Software leveraged ETFs (METU, PLTU, MSFU) to reduce risk.
Add a new, high-scoring long setup (ZS) for potential growth.
Maintain a balanced mix of broad index and quality tech holdings.
Keep a moderate cash buffer for flexibility.
Focus on controlled growth with risk management as the priority.
balanced.read: This balanced approach seeks growth while managing risk. Expect moderate returns with controlled drawdowns. The addition of a new high-quality name aims to enhance upside potential.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to maximize potential gains.
Add to concentrated AI/Software leveraged ETFs (METU, PLTU, MSFU) for aggressive growth.
Add a new, high-scoring long setup (ZS) to further concentrate on strong performers.
Maintain a smaller cash buffer to maximize invested capital.
Utilize wider stops to allow for normal volatility.
Focus on aggressive growth, accepting higher potential drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for maximum growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and faster losses. Leveraged ETF decay is a key risk.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names to remove volatility.
Significantly increase allocation to the income ETF (QQQI) for monthly distributions.
Maintain broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) for stability and some growth potential.
Hold a substantial cash buffer to maximize income generation.
Prioritize capital preservation and reliable income over aggressive growth.
Focus on generating steady monthly income with low drawdowns.
income.read: This income-focused plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and capital preservation. Expect lower overall growth compared to other modes, but with significantly reduced volatility and risk. Distributions are not guaranteed and NAV can still decline.
